## RSS job digest
Daily At Seven uses cron 0 7 * * * (07:00 UTC).
Read Public Job Feed loads the public Jobicy job feed at https://jobicy.com/?feed=job_feed.
Source: Jobicy (jobicy.com), used with attribution.
Keep Keyword Matches keeps items whose title, snippet, or link contains engineer, developer, python, or remote.
Drop Already Sent Items hides ids already stored in workflow static data.
Send Digest Email sends one plain-text summary. Mark Items Sent runs only after that node, so a failed send can be retried the next day.

## Setup
The RSS URL is a public feed and needs no credential.
Attach an SMTP credential on Send Digest Email.
Set WORKFLOWKIT_FROM and WORKFLOWKIT_TO in the n8n environment.
Edit DEFAULT_KEYWORDS inside Keep Keyword Matches to change the filter.
The digest lists at most 20 new items.
